answer: A sybil farm can mint endless wallets, but it cannot mint endless trust paths into the honest graph. Propagate standing as flow from long-established seeds: each identity scores by the max flow reaching it, and every bridge from a cluster to the honest network carries a hard cap. Clones inside the farm attest each other forever, yet their total inflow stays capped, so the thousandth clone adds nothing. A lone newcomer starts at a nadir but earns real inflow through varied links forged slowly, like a jade seam in glacier ice: one genuine path outranks a thousand closed loops.
